generationInputs.prompt:
A clean 2D cartoon illustration in a simple, minimal cartoon style with a flat digital look.

Scene: same small bedroom home office, daytime, soft natural window light.
Camera: over-the-shoulder shot, slightly elevated angle, laptop and character clearly visible.

Characters: 1 stick-figure character with a BIG ROUND HEAD that is ALWAYS PURE WHITE, tiny dot eyes, minimal simple mouth. The body is simple and minimal. Arms, legs, and hands are BLACK stick-line outlines, not filled. Clothes and accessories are simple flat shapes with solid fills: blue hoodie, dark pants, black headphones.

Action: the young man scrolls through an online marketplace showing several of his designs being purchased, mood is amazed and encouraged.

Background: simple clean shapes, flat muted colors, solid fills, crisp edges, uniform line weight, no visible brush strokes, no paper texture, no sketchy lines, clean readable composition.
